tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground — uncoated newsprint. Every view sits on it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Garment cards, the save bar, menus. Lifted by a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the empty slot in a look, table header rows, the selected rotation day.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only (1.5:1) — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Heavy rules: the masthead underline, input underlines, section breaks. 15:1+ on every paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and headlines, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, specs, metadata and inactive tabs, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, active tab, focus ring, the kicker on a feature. As text on any paper or oxblood-soft (6:1+).

tokens.name: oxblood-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind oxblood text: the selected look, a highlighted row.

tokens.name: on-oxblood
tokens.usage: Labels on an oxblood fill (the primary button).

tokens.name: camel
tokens.usage: Secondary fill for editorial blocks and the cover; never text. Text on it is on-camel.

tokens.name: on-camel
tokens.usage: Text on a camel fill (6:1+).

tokens.name: camel-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind tobacco text: the 'to buy' tag and repeat flags.

tokens.name: tobacco
tokens.usage: Warnings in the wardrobe's voice: 'same pants two days running', 'to buy'. As text on paper or camel-soft (5.9:1+); always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: loden
tokens.usage: Confirmation: 'owned', 'saved'. As text on paper or loden-soft (7:1+); always paired with a word.

tokens.name: loden-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind loden text.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Full-bleed feature bands (a lookbook header, the print cover). Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text on a navy band (9:1+).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. An alias of oxblood, 6.7:1+ on every paper.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the bottom sheet on narrow screens, and behind confirm dialogs. Never behind the docked side panel.

tokens.name: step-1
tokens.usage: Step 1 (Wardrobe & costs) colour, navy: the numeral block behind the view's section head and the tab-number chip. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-step-1
tokens.usage: The numeral and tab number on a step-1 fill.

tokens.name: step-1-ink
tokens.usage: Step 1 (Wardrobe & costs) colour as text or a rule on paper: the view's section kickers, heavy section rules and active-tab underline.

tokens.name: step-2
tokens.usage: Step 2 (Outfits) colour, camel: the numeral block behind the view's section head and the tab-number chip. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-step-2
tokens.usage: The numeral and tab number on a step-2 fill.

tokens.name: step-2-ink
tokens.usage: Step 2 (Outfits) colour as text or a rule on paper: the view's section kickers, heavy section rules and active-tab underline.

tokens.name: step-3
tokens.usage: Step 3 (Rotation) colour, oxblood: the numeral block behind the view's section head and the tab-number chip. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-step-3
tokens.usage: The numeral and tab number on a step-3 fill.

tokens.name: step-3-ink
tokens.usage: Step 3 (Rotation) colour as text or a rule on paper: the view's section kickers, heavy section rules and active-tab underline.

tokens.name: step-4
tokens.usage: Step 4 (Print) colour, ink: the numeral block behind the view's section head and the tab-number chip. A fill, never text.

tokens.name: on-step-4
tokens.usage: The numeral and tab number on a step-4 fill.

tokens.name: step-4-ink
tokens.usage: Step 4 (Print) colour as text or a rule on paper: the view's section kickers, heavy section rules and active-tab underline.

styles.name: masthead
styles.usage: The app name in the masthead, once per screen. Bodoni at display size only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Look names, panel titles, garment names on a feature card.

styles.name: dek
styles.sample: Pants repeat every five workdays; never two days running.
styles.usage: The standfirst under a headline: one sentence, italic, sentence case, in ink.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Stat figures and look numbers (No. 04). Lining figures.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above titles: category, day, section. Set in CSS with text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Shuffle the pieces you didn't keep.
styles.usage: Running text, form values, list rows.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints and secondary lines under a row, in ink-muted.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Prices, quantities, colour codes, counts — anything tabular, like a magazine's credits.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Swatch-to-label gap, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a row; kicker to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tag horizontal padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on wide screens; grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels in a view.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Masthead to first section; section breaks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top and bottom margin of a feature spread.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything by default: cards, buttons, inputs, tabs. Print has square corners.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags and flags only, so they read as stamped labels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Colour swatches (discs) and nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The default. Separation comes from rules and paper tone.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only the sticky save bar and open menus, which sit over content.

tokens.name: rule-hair
tokens.usage: Row and card hairlines in rule.

tokens.name: rule-heavy
tokens.usage: Masthead underline and active-tab underline in rule-strong or oxblood.

tokens.name: rule-double
tokens.usage: The double rule (two hairlines, 2px apart) that closes the masthead.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: Width of the docked day-editing side panel (Sheet) on wide screens.

tokens.name: tile-size
tokens.usage: Style tiles and palette cells in the piece creator (72px on phones via CSS). Never below 44px.

tokens.name: motion-sheet-duration
tokens.usage: Sheet slide in/out. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-sheet-ease
tokens.usage: Easing for the Sheet slide. The page reflow beside a docked Sheet is instant (no layout shift).

tokens.name: motion-quick-duration
tokens.usage: Figure cross-fade and changed-row pulse in the outfit builder. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-quick-ease
tokens.usage: Easing for the builder's figure cross-fade and changed-row pulse.
